title: TransHarness: From Benchmark Overfitting to Transferable Harness Evolution
authors: Tianze Xia, Zimo Wang, Heng Tong, Zhaoxiang Liu, Shiguo Lian, Fan Huang, Wenyu Liu, Yunchao Wei, Xinggang Wang
publish: arXiv
abstract: Harness evolution offers a path to improving coding agents without updating model weights. However, existing methods can overfit their evolution benchmarks, producing gains that fail to carry over to new tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Transferable Harness Evolution (TransHarness), which evolves harness intervention policies from same-task success-failure contrasts. These policies couple execution-context triggers with diagnostic guidance, enabling task-dependent checks and corrections beyond the source executions. Cross-task replay and independent semantic selection retain policies that intervene selectively and ground corrections in current-task evidence rather than source-specific solutions. We further curate an independent evolution set for cross-distribution transfer and conduct a cross-benchmark evaluation covering multiple strong models and a range of lightweight and mature harnesses. Experiments show that, with only 300 source trajectories from outside the test distribution, TransHarness further improves strong agents across distinct target benchmarks, demonstrating transferable harness evolution beyond benchmark overfitting. Specifically, TransHarness achieves state-of-the-art scores of 76.4% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 95.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, surpassing the strongest baseline model, GPT-6 Astra, by 2.4 and 5.6 percentage points, respectively.
title_zh: TransHarness：从基准过拟合到可迁移的进化工具
abstract_zh: 利用进化提供了一种无需更新模型权重即可改进编码代理的途径。然而，现有方法可能会过度拟合其进化基准，产生的增益无法迁移到新任务中。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了可迁移的利用进化（TransHarness），该方法通过同任务的成功-失败对比来进化利用干预策略。这些策略将执行上下文触发器与诊断指导相结合，使代理能够执行超越源执行的、依赖于任务的检查和修正。跨任务重放和独立语义选择保留了选择性干预的策略，并将修正基于当前任务证据而非特定源解决方案。我们进一步整理了一个独立的进化集用于跨分布迁移，并进行了跨基准评估，涵盖了多个强大模型以及一系列轻量级和成熟的利用方法。实验表明，仅使用来自测试分布之外的300个源轨迹，TransHarness就能在不同目标基准上进一步提升强大代理的性能，展示了超越基准过度拟合的可迁移利用进化。具体而言，TransHarness在DeepSWE v1.1上实现了76.4%的最先进分数，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上实现了95.5%的分数，分别比最强的基线模型GPT-6 Astra高出2.4和5.6个百分点。

title: Lightweight Reasoning Transfer via Chain-of-Thought Vector Projection
authors: Yulin Qi, Shuo Xu, Shuxia Lin, Qingjian Ni, Xu Yang, Xin Geng
publish: arXiv
abstract: Transferring reasoning capabilities from large language models to smaller ones often requires extensive teacher supervision or costly student adaptation. We study projected cross-model Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Vector transfer, a two-stage approach that keeps both models frozen. First, we learn a task-level CoT Vector in the teacher using dataset-provided solution traces and final-answer supervision. We then train a lightweight linear projector to map the fixed vector into a smaller student's residual space. Student-side training uses only final-answer cross-entropy on a small subset of task training examples; it requires neither teacher outputs nor intermediate solution traces. We select the student injection layer and intervention scale on a labeled support set and report results on the disjoint remainder of each evaluation split. On GSM8K and MATH, the projected vector improves base students by 10.37-21.98 accuracy points across the evaluated teacher-student settings. On four code-generation benchmarks, the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct student gains 3.23-4.67 pass@1 points, while the base Qwen2.5-7B student gains up to 9.65 points. These results show that a teacher-side reasoning vector can be reused across smaller students with different residual dimensions through projector-only adaptation.
title_zh: 通过思维链向量投影实现轻量级推理迁移
abstract_zh: 将大型语言模型的推理能力转移到小型模型上通常需要大量的教师监督或高昂的学生模型适应成本。我们研究了投影跨模型思维链（CoT）向量迁移，这是一种两阶段方法，保持两个模型均冻结不变。首先，我们在教师模型中使用数据集提供的解题轨迹和最终答案监督来学习任务级别的CoT向量。然后，我们训练一个轻量级线性投影器，将固定向量映射到较小学生模型的残差空间中。学生端训练仅使用任务训练数据集的一小部分进行最终答案交叉熵训练，既不需要教师模型的输出，也不需要中间解题轨迹。我们在标记的支持集上选择学生注入层和干预尺度，并在每个评估分割的剩余不相交部分报告结果。在GSM8K和MATH数据集上，投影向量在所评估的教师-学生设置中使基础学生模型的准确度提高了10.37-21.98个百分点。在四个代码生成基准测试中，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct学生模型获得了3.23-4.67的pass@1分数提升，而基础Qwen2.5-7B学生模型最高提升了9.65分。这些结果表明，教师端的推理向量可以通过仅适应投影器的方式，在不同残差维度的小型学生模型间重复使用。

title: When Are Parallel Subagents Effective for Coding? An Empirical Study on Repository Construction
authors: Zhiheng Lyu, Chengyu Yin, Lingming Zhang
publish: arXiv
abstract: LLM-based coding agents are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks such as building an entire program from a specification. Products like Codex and Claude Code let an agent delegate work to parallel subagents, multiplying run cost, yet it remains unclear whether and when delegation produces a better program. We compare a single agent with a main agent delegating to subagents on repository-construction tasks from NL2Repo and ProgramBench (which also provides an executable reference program). We compare scores at equal time and equal cost, run intervention experiments, and analyze fine-grained behavior. On randomly drawn tasks, parallel subagents raise hidden-test pass rates by only about 1 to 5 percentage points at up to 3.8x the cost of a single agent. Their gain is larger on hard tasks, where we find evidence of three mechanisms. Self-checking: with GPT-5.6 Sol, one sentence telling a single agent to probe the reference program first recovers most of this gain at a fraction of the cost; from GPT-5.6 Sol to GPT-6.1 Sol, the gain shrinks as single agents check their own work more. Fresh context: in extended runs, a single agent that periodically starts a new session with an empty conversation makes faster early progress in every comparison than one that resumes its conversation. Modularity: multi-agent runs produce more modular code (more files and shorter functions), closer to the upstream source. We observe similar patterns in a smaller replication with Opus 5.5 on Claude Code. Overall, subagents help when (i) a single agent stops checking too early, (ii) a long session keeps editing with little improvement, or (iii) modular code helps on the task; otherwise, they mainly add cost.
title_zh: 并行子代理何时对编程有效？关于仓库构建的实证研究
abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的编码代理越来越多地用于长周期任务，例如根据规范构建整个程序。像Codex和Claude Code这样的产品允许代理将工作委托给并行子代理，从而增加了运行成本，但目前尚不清楚委托在何种情况下以及何时能产生更好的程序。我们在NL2Repo和ProgramBench（也提供了可执行的参考程序）的仓库构建任务中，比较了单个代理与主代理委托给子代理的情况。我们在相同时间和相同成本下比较得分，进行运行干预实验，并分析细粒度行为。在随机抽取的任务中，并行子代理仅在成本高达单个代理3.8倍的情况下，将隐藏测试的通过率仅提高了约1到5个百分点。在困难任务上，它们的收益更大，我们发现了三种机制的证据。自我检查：使用GPT-5.6 Sol时，只需一句话告诉单个代理先检查参考程序，就能以一小部分成本恢复大部分收益；从GPT-5.6 Sol到GPT-6.1 Sol，随着单个代理更多地检查自己的工作，收益逐渐减少。新鲜上下文：在扩展运行中，定期以空对话开始新会话的单个代理，比恢复对话的代理在每次比较中都能更快地取得早期进展。模块化：多代理运行产生更多模块化的代码（更多文件和更短的函数），更接近上游源代码。我们在Claude Code上使用Opus 5.5进行的小规模复制实验中观察到了类似的模式。总体而言，当（i）单个代理过早停止检查，（ii）长时间会话持续编辑但改进甚微，或（iii）模块化代码对任务有帮助时，子代理才有帮助；否则，它们主要增加成本。

title: PowerFix: Physics-Guided Iterative Repair for LLM-Assisted Power Converter Design
authors: Can Wang, Shi Qiu, Fanfan Lin
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for automated engineering design. However, repairing power-converter designs that fail engineering validation remains challenging: the system must identify physical causes, locate responsible design variables, and resolve violations without compromising other constraints. We introduce PowerFix, a physics-guided iterative repair framework that converts validation failures into structured diagnoses and executable patches while preserving topology and design requirements. PowerDiagGraph links failed checks to possible physical causes and constrains repair routes. An LLM prioritizes these routes, while a deterministic compiler translates selected repairs into authorized field-level edits. Candidates are validated on isolated design copies and committed only after all required engineering checks pass; failed validation can guide replanning. On our constructed 96-task flyback repair benchmark, comprising injected single faults, coupled faults, and held-out natural failures from our design generator, PowerFix achieves 78.7% verified repair success rate (VRSR), compared with 30.1% for the strongest of three LLM baselines. Three additional replanning rounds increase VRSR to 88.4%. These offline results provide pilot-stage evidence within a simulation-based design workflow, with hardware prototype validation and transfer to a second converter topology as the next steps toward deployment.
title_zh: PowerFix：面向LLM辅助电源转换器设计的物理引导迭代修复
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)代理正越来越多地被探索用于自动化工程设计。然而，修复未能通过工程验证的功率转换器设计仍然具有挑战性：系统必须识别物理原因，定位负责的设计变量，并在不违反其他约束的情况下解决违规问题。我们介绍了PowerFix，这是一个物理引导的迭代修复框架，它将验证失败转换为结构化诊断和可执行的补丁，同时保持拓扑结构和设计要求。PowerDiagGraph将失败的检查链接到可能的物理原因，并约束修复路径。LLM优先考虑这些路径，而确定性编译器将选定的修复转换为授权的字段级编辑。候选修复在隔离的设计副本上进行验证，只有在所有必需的工程检查通过后才被提交；验证失败可以指导重新规划。在我们构建的包含96个任务的返驰式修复基准测试中（包含注入的单故障、耦合故障以及从我们的设计生成器中保留的自然故障），PowerFix实现了78.7%的已验证修复成功率(VRSR)，而三个最强的LLM基线中最好的只有30.1%。另外三轮重新规划将VRSR提高到88.4%。这些离线结果在基于仿真的设计工作流中提供了初步阶段的证据，硬件原型验证以及转移到第二种转换器拓扑结构是下一步部署的方向。

title: Reproducer Synthesis for AI-Reported Bugs in the Linux Kernel
authors: Xiao Wu, Yunbo Ni, Hao Sun, Yuanyuan Yuan, Shaohua Li
publish: arXiv
abstract: Agentic review systems are increasingly flagging suspected bugs in Linux kernel patches as textual reports. A maintainer who receives such reports needs further inspection to determine whether the report is true. The inspection requires understanding whether the bug can be triggered and, if necessary, manually constructing one. As a consequence, despite the excessive textual explanation, many reports go unanswered. In this paper, we argue that a runnable proof-of-concept (PoC) is the key information in such AI-generated kernel review reports. It is, however, challenging to automatically synthesize a valid and runnable PoC. We present ReproCue, a framework that generates PoCs for AI-generated Linux kernel reviews. ReproCue replays the historical kernel bugs and learns one reproduction finite-state-machine (FSM) per subsystem from successful runs. An FSM records the steps a reproduction goes through, together with the requirements observed at each step. Given a new review, ReproCue follows the FSM of that subsystem, adjusting the PoC and the environment as execution shows what is missing. In 100 recent AI-generated reviews, ReproCue writes PoCs for 49 of them, compared with 10 for the current agentic reproducer and 9 for the state-of-the-art directed fuzzing. Excitingly, with our generated PoCs, Linux kernel maintainers confirmed 69.4% of them, much higher than 9.3% from Sashiko where only textual explanations are included, making AI reviews more actionable in practice.
title_zh: Linux内核中AI报告错误的复现器合成
abstract_zh: 代理审查系统越来越多地将Linux内核补丁中的疑似错误标记为文本报告。收到此类报告的维护人员需要进一步检查以确定报告是否属实。这种检查需要理解错误是否可以被触发，并在必要时手动构建触发方法。因此，尽管有大量的文本解释，许多报告仍然没有得到回应。在本文中，我们认为，可运行的漏洞证明(PoC)是这类AI生成的内核审查报告中的关键信息。然而，自动合成有效且可运行的PoC具有挑战性。我们提出了ReproCue，一个为AI生成的Linux内核审查生成PoC的框架。ReproCue回放历史内核错误，并从成功的运行中为每个子系统学习一个有限状态机(FSM)。FSM记录了复现过程经历的步骤，以及每一步观察到的要求。对于新的审查，ReproCue遵循相应子系统的FSM，根据执行情况调整PoC和环境，以发现缺失的部分。在最近的100个AI生成的审查中，ReproCue为其中的49个编写了PoC，而当前的代理复现器和最先进的定向模糊测试分别只能为10个和9个生成。令人兴奋的是，使用我们生成的PoC，Linux内核维护人员确认了其中的69.4%，远高于仅包含文本解释的Sashiko的9.3%，这使得AI审查在实践中更具可操作性。

title: REFORGE: LLM-Assisted RTL Bug Repair with Structured Context and Verification Feedback
authors: Tanvir Hossain, Sudipta Paria, Aidan Gleason Myers, Swarup Bhunia, Tamzidul Hoque
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can write and repair RTL, but successful compilation or testbench execution does not establish defect removal, behavioral preservation, security, or implementation feasibility. Existing LLM-based RTL repair methods often report a single repair rate without retaining separate evidence for these properties, limiting reproducible comparison and integration into hardware design flows. We present REFORGE, which, to our knowledge, is the first LLM-assisted RTL repair framework that maintains and accumulates structured repair evidence across iterations, allowing it to generate fixes that satisfy multiple objectives simultaneously, including functionality, behavioral equivalence, security, and cost efficiency. REFORGE profiles buggy RTL, identifies structural and security-relevant features, localizes failing behavior, and uses verification-guided diagnosis to generate complete RTL repair variants. Each variant undergoes syntax checking, simulation, formal analysis, off-trigger preservation, security re-scan, and synthesis-based power, performance, and area analysis. We implement REFORGE as a backend-independent repair-and-verification flow and evaluate it in 288 runs across three LLM backends and three benchmark suites. On CirFix, the proposed context and diagnosis increase runs delivering a checked repair from 32/63 to 51/63, while every configuration repairs the Hack@DAC OpenTitan defect. Evidence records also show that a testbench-only criterion reports 3.9 times more repairs than the full set of applicable checks, security-clean outputs may lack functional verification, and different RTL repairs can implement equivalent hardware. These results show that LLM-generated RTL repairs require explicit multi-stage verification evidence rather than a single pass/fail outcome.
title_zh: REFORGE：基于结构化上下文和验证反馈的LLM辅助RTL Bug修复
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够编写和修复RTL（寄存器传输级代码），但成功的编译或测试台执行并不能证明缺陷已被移除、行为得到保留、安全性或实现可行性。现有的基于LLM的RTL修复方法通常只报告单一的修复率，而没有保留这些属性的独立证据，这限制了可复现的比较以及与硬件设计流程的集成。我们提出了REFORGE，据我们所知，这是第一个LLM辅助的RTL修复框架，能够在迭代过程中维护和积累结构化的修复证据，使其能够生成同时满足多个目标的修复方案，包括功能性、行为等效性、安全性和成本效率。REFORGE对有缺陷的RTL进行分析，识别结构和安全相关特征，定位失败行为，并使用验证引导的诊断方法生成完整的RTL修复变体。每个变体都经过语法检查、仿真、形式化分析、触发器保留、安全重新扫描以及基于合成的功耗、性能和面积分析。我们将REFORGE实现为一个后端独立的修复和验证流程，并在三个LLM后端和三个基准测试套件上进行了288次运行评估。在CirFix上，所提出的上下文和诊断将提供已检查修复的运行次数从32/63增加到51/63，而每个配置都修复了Hack@DAC OpenTitan缺陷。证据记录还显示，仅基于测试台的标准报告的修复次数比全套适用检查多3.9倍，安全清洁的输出可能缺乏功能验证，并且不同的RTL修复可以实现等效的硬件。这些结果表明，LLM生成的RTL修复需要明确的多阶段验证证据，而不是单一的通过/失败结果。

title: How Much Effort Does an AI Code Reviewer Need? Evidence from Claude 5.5 Models on Plausible-but-Wrong Patches
authors: Zax Shen, Hanling Zhang, Zixu Wang
publish: arXiv
abstract: AI coding agents write code faster than people can review it, so teams add AI reviewers. Reasoning models let such a reviewer trade cost for diligence through an effort setting. We asked how much effort a reviewer needs to catch plausible-but-wrong patches, which pass a benchmark's tests but fail stronger ones. Claude Opus 5.5 (preregistered), Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 (exploratory) each reviewed the same 90 agent-written Django patches from SWE-bench Verified at low, medium and high effort. By strengthened SWE-ABS tests, 55 patches were wrong and 35 correct. In every model, high effort accepted fewer wrong patches than low (false success .45 against .67 for Opus, .49 against .65 for Sonnet, .51 against .78 for Haiku), a supported difference for Opus and Haiku. For Opus, medium was non-inferior to high within 15 percentage points (difference .018, 95% CI [-.065, .108]) and cost 20% less, short of the preregistered 30%. For Sonnet and Haiku, medium cost 39% and 51% less than high but was not shown non-inferior. Opus at medium or high agreed best with the labels; Haiku at high cost about 8% as much per review as Opus at medium, accuracy difference unresolved. Exploratory coding showed that most rejections named the tested defect and that effort added such rejections. No setting is a strong gate: each accepted at least 45% of wrong patches. For 32 of the 55 wrong patches the issue may not require what the failing test checks; without them, neither accuracy hypothesis holds for any model.
title_zh: AI代码审查需要多少努力？来自Claude 5.5模型在看似合理但错误的补丁上的证据
abstract_zh: AI编码代理编写代码的速度超过了人工审查的速度，因此团队添加了AI审查者。推理模型使这样的审查者能够通过努力设置来权衡成本和细致程度。我们研究了审查者需要付出多少努力才能发现看似合理但错误的代码补丁——这些补丁通过了基准测试，但在更严格的测试中失败了。Claude Opus 5.5（预注册）、Sonnet 5.5和Haiku 5.5（探索性）分别在低、中、高三种努力程度上审查了相同的90个来自SWE-bench Verified的Django代码补丁。通过加强的SWE-ABS测试，其中55个补丁是错误的，35个是正确的。对于每个模型，高努力程度接受的错误补丁比低努力程度少（Opus的错误接受率为0.45对0.67，Sonnet为0.49对0.65，Haiku为0.51对0.78），Opus和Haiku的这一差异具有统计支持。对于Opus，中等努力程度在15个百分点内不劣于高努力程度（差异0.018，95% CI [-0.065, 0.108]），且成本低20%，未达到预注册的30%减少目标。对于Sonnet和Haiku，中等努力程度的成本比高努力程度分别低39%和51%，但未证明其非劣效性。Opus在中等或高努力程度上与标签的一致性最好；Haiku在高努力程度下的每审查成本约为Opus在中等努力程度下的8%，准确性差异尚未解决。探索性编码表明，大多数拒绝指出了测试中的缺陷，而增加努力程度会带来更多的此类拒绝。没有哪种设置是强有力的把关者：每种设置至少接受了45%的错误补丁。在55个错误补丁中，有32个的问题可能不需要失败测试所检查的内容；如果没有这些测试，任何模型的准确性假设都不成立。

title: Asymmetric Speculative Decoding: Unlocking In-Context Learning in Draft Models
authors: Guang Huang, Zeyi Wen
publish: arXiv
abstract: Speculative decoding addresses Large Language Model (LLM) inference latency by first drafting and then verifying in parallel. Yet practical speedups fall far short of theoretical bounds, especially on reasoning tasks. We identify the root cause as task isomorphism: existing methods provide identical prompts to both models, forcing the draft model to solve problems beyond its capacity. This produces high rejection rates that eliminate parallelization gains. We discover that acceptance rates increase monotonically during generation, revealing a latent in-context learning (ICL) effect wherein the draft model progressively aligns with the target distribution by learning from verified tokens. Controlled experiments with varying context window sizes confirm this improvement stems from ICL-driven alignment rather than token difficulty. Motivated by this finding, we propose Asymmetric Speculative Decoding (AsymSpec), a training-free framework that decouples the prompts provided to draft and target models. By supplying the draft model with task-relevant example solutions, we reformulate its objective from reasoning to simulation, amplifying the ICL effect from the first token. We prove AsymSpec produces exact samples and converges exponentially to the target distribution. Across reasoning, code generation, and summarization tasks, AsymSpec achieves 2.29$\times$ to 4.95$\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding, outperforming standard speculative decoding without model retraining.
title_zh: 非对称推测解码：在草稿模型中解锁上下文学习能力
abstract_zh: 推测解码通过先草拟再并行验证的方式解决大型语言模型(LLM)的推理延迟问题。然而，实际加速效果远低于理论界限，特别是在推理任务上。我们确定根本原因是任务同构性：现有方法为两个模型提供相同的提示，迫使草稿模型解决超出其能力范围的问题。这导致高拒绝率，消除了并行化的增益。我们发现接受率在生成过程中单调递增，揭示了一种潜在的上下文学习(ICL)效应，即草稿模型通过学习已验证的令牌，逐渐与目标分布对齐。通过改变上下文窗口大小的对照实验证实，这种改进源于ICL驱动的对齐，而非令牌难度。受此发现启发，我们提出了非训练框架非对称推测解码(AsymSpec)，该框架解耦了提供给草稿模型和目标模型的提示。通过为草稿模型提供任务相关的示例解决方案，我们将其目标从推理重新定义为模拟，从第一个令牌开始增强ICL效应。我们证明了AsymSpec能够产生精确样本并指数级收敛到目标分布。在推理、代码生成和摘要任务中，AsymSpec比自回归解码实现了2.29倍至4.95倍的加速，无需重新训练模型即可优于标准推测解码。

title: Kolpona: An Agentic Framework with Gradient-Free Neuron Programming for RTL Generation
authors: Musa Tur Farazi, Md Nasir Uddin, Soumik Bhattacharjee, Tishna Sabrina, Chowdhury Mohammad Rakin Haider
publish: arXiv
abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) for register-transfer level (RTL) design are usually improved by fine-tuning on curated Verilog corpora, which needs large sets of verified designs and GPU training. We present Kolpona, an agentic framework that improves such models without gradient training. Its first component is neuron programming, a new form of weight-space programming (WSP) that writes single neurons in closed form into the weights to remove failure habits found on practice tasks, and keeps each edit only when testbench results on fresh tasks favour it. At inference time, tool-using agents propose designs, and a label-free selection stage delivers one design per task from the specification, the candidates and their simulations alone. On Qwen3.5-4B, edits to 16 neurons raise the VerilogEval v2 pass@1 of the model alone from 31.7% to 55.4%, and the full framework reaches 77.6%. On Qwen3.8-27B, Kolpona lifts pass@1 from 73.1% to 94.9% on VerilogEval v2 and from 66.0% to 92.0% on RTLLM v2.1 on a single 32 GB GPU, above every published system in our comparison. The RTL edits also carry over to Python and raise the pass@1 of the 4B model alone from 84.8% to 91.5% on HumanEval+ and from 67.7% to 77.5% on MBPP+.
title_zh: Kolpona：一种用于RTL生成的无梯度神经元编程智能体框架
abstract_zh: 用于寄存器传输级(RTL)设计的开源大型语言模型(LLMs)通常通过精心挑选的Verilog语料库进行微调来改进，这需要大量经过验证的设计和GPU训练。我们提出了Kolpona，一个智能体框架，可以在不进行梯度训练的情况下改进此类模型。其第一个组件是神经元编程，这是一种新型的权重空间编程(WSP)，它将单个神经元以闭式形式写入权重中，以去除在实际任务中发现的失败习惯，并且只有在测试任务上的测试台结果支持时才保留每次编辑。在推理时，使用工具的智能体提出设计方案，无标签选择阶段仅根据规范、候选方案及其模拟结果为每个任务交付一个设计。在Qwen3.5-4B上，对16个神经元的编辑将模型单独在VerilogEval v2上的pass@1从31.7%提高到55.4%，而完整框架达到77.6%。在Qwen3.8-27B上，Kolpona在VerilogEval v2上将pass@1从73.1%提高到94.9%，在RTLLM v2.1上从66.0%提高到92.0%，仅需单个32 GB GPU，高于我们比较中发布的所有系统。RTL编辑也适用于Python，将4B模型单独在HumanEval+上的pass@1从84.8%提高到91.5%，在MBPP+上从67.7%提高到77.5%。
